title.narrative: Doing Business at Federal government of Somalia- Support to data collection and development of reform memo

target.value: Facilitate enactment of the Companies Act 2019, support advisory reports reviewing key sectoral legislations, support drafting of Doing Business Action Plan

actual.value: At Federal Government of Somalia, facilitated enactment of the Companies Act 2019, supported advisory reports reviewing key sectoral laws and support drafting of Doing Business Action Plan. At federal level, facilitated two Doing Business reform training events

target.value: Conduct Business registration baseline survey at federal level and support Doing Business reform update memo

actual.value: Completed Business registration baseline survey at federal level and supported Doing Business reform update memo to the World Bank's Doing Business Team.

target.value: Launch of Somalia Trade Information Portal

actual.value: Somalia Trade Information Portal launched

target.value: Support to drafting of implementation regulations under the Companies Act, drafting of the Business Licensing Bill. Submit final version of of company regulations, the business licensing bill and national building and standards policy for Government' endorsement . In Somaliland, complete a vendor for business registration one stop shop and initiate the development of the system.

actual.value: Supported drafting of Business License Law and regulations to implement the companies Law, the two Laws were adopted

target.value: Continue with the capacity building support to Ministry of Commerce and chamber of Commerce

actual.value: Supported the business environment reform in Somalia and SL, as well as improved trade facilitation. A total of 52 workshops, training events and seminars were held. the Fund provided support to enactment of the companies’ law and supported the development and launch of the online business registration system at the federal level. The number of firms benefitting from the reformed registration and licensing requirements increased from 764 firms, to 1247, surpassing the project target of 1000.

title.narrative: Market scoping and deep dives of opportunities for innovative financial products and services

target.value: Implementation phase of 4 sector level activities

actual.value: 3 deep dive dissemination events were held, presenting survey data on financial services. The deep dives showed that the level of financial inclusion has significantly increased in Somalia over the last decade, driven by mobile money. 3 diagnostic reports published and disseminated on: agri-financial services demand and supply, on credit reporting and secured transaction registries.

target.value: Finalise sector deep dives in Somaliland and Somalia to identify market opportunities for innovative financial products and services.

actual.value: Market scoping still ongoing, drafting of diagnostic reports ongoing

target.value: Convene stakeholders meeting of all known microfinance players in Somaliland, In Federal level-launch of diagnostics meeting with central banks and relevant financial institions in Hargeisa and Mogadishu on credit reporting and moveable collateral registries

actual.value: Meeting of microfinance stakeholders held in Hargeisa in September 2019, IFC launched two diagnostics meetings with central banks and financial institutions in Mogadishu and Hargeisa.

target.value: Produce 10 needs analysis reports with proposed solutions for credit referencing and collateral registries.

actual.value: Produced 18 reports (assessments, surveys, manuals, strategic option reports, research, analytical and evaluations).
